deer.description: Herd grazer; feeds in open ground and returns to cover to sleep.

rabbit.description: Twilight forager; stays near its home and flees predators.

boar.description: Night-time woodland rooter; travels socially and seeks moist habitat.

wolf.description: Social night hunter; scavenges first, hunts when hungry, rests when fed.

fox.description: Solitary twilight hunter of small prey; returns to its own territory.

bear.description: Solitary omnivore; forages and scavenges, conserving energy in winter.

goat.description: Social highland browser; feeds by day and rests near its home.

duck.description: Water-edge flock forager; eats wetland plants and rests at night.
